name: Garlic and Rosemary Lamb Chops
ingredients: 2 lb - Lamb Loin or Rib Chops Thick Cut
instructions: Prepare marinade. Combine the garlic, rosemary, salt, pepper, lemon zest and olive oil in a measuring cup.
Pour marinade over the lamb chops; flip to cover completely. Cover and marinate the chops in the fridge for at least an hour  (or overnight).
When ready to cook, remove from fridge and bring to room temperature. About 30  minutes.
Grill the lamb chops on medium heat 3-4 minutes per side, or until internal temperature  is 135˚F.
Rest chops on a plate covered with aluminum foil for 5 minutes before serving
